commands.review_summary:
The branch adds a ten-minute timeout with `SIGKILL` to bundled plugin asset-hook commands and adds a regression test for a Node hook that ignores `SIGTERM`.

PR surface: Tests +43, Other +14. Total +57 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source: configure an asset hook command that launches a long-lived child through the runner’s existing shell, exceed the timeout, and verify whether the descendant remains alive. Node’s documented shell-child behavior makes this a high-confidence missing case, although it was not executed in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] The blocker is a narrow, mechanical repair to timeout cleanup and regression coverage; it does not require product or API-direction judgment.

target.title: fix: builds stop hanging on stalled plugin asset hooks
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where local builds, source CLI rebuilds, macOS restarts, Docker builds, CI, or release jobs could hang indefinitely when a bundled plugin asset build or copy hook stalled.

## Why This Change Was Made

Each plugin-owned asset hook now has a 10-minute deadline, matching existing build and release command ceilings. The runner uses `SIGKILL` because Node's synchronous child-process API can keep waiting when a timed-out child handles `SIGTERM`; timeout errors identify only the phase and plugin id, without forwarding child error details.

## User Impact

Developers and release operators now get a bounded, actionable failure instead of an indefinitely blocked build. Successful Browser, Canvas, Diffs, and Discord asset generation keeps the existing commands and output behavior.

## Evidence

Exact head: `59b39bffae634f850ca06678def1367ad0dade6e`

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/bundled-plugin-assets.test.ts` — 8/8 passed. The regression test runs a real Node asset hook that ignores `SIGTERM`, verifies the runner returns before the child's two-second fallback exit, and confirms the child process is gone.
- Real stalled-hook transcript from the changed runner:

```text
[proof-plugin] build: node scripts/stall.mjs
{"elapsedMs":116,"code":"ETIMEDOUT","message":"Bundled plugin asset build hook timed out after 100ms: proof-plugin","childAliveAfter":false}
```

- Real successful path: `node scripts/bundled-plugin-assets.mjs --phase build --plugin discord` generated the missing Discord Embedded App SDK bundle and exited successfully; resulting SHA-256: `72a78cd678dada982e7109aa31488f1c7cd85ad76e933e0d080a0bd9cf6ac6c7`.
- `oxfmt --check scripts/bundled-plugin-assets.mjs test/scripts/bundled-plugin-assets.test.ts` — passed.
- Targeted Oxlint for both changed files — passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — passed.
- The changed-check wrapper passed conflict markers, attribution, extension boundaries, dependency pins, formatting, patch guards, temp-file checks, and script declarations. Its root-test typecheck then stopped on unrelated shared-install errors in `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` and `src/infra/boundary-file-read.ts`; this branch does not change those files. Exact-head CI is the clean-install typecheck.
